name: Genesis of the Daleks
oracle_text:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after IV.)
I, II, III — Create a 3/3 black Dalek artifact creature token with menace for each lore counter on Genesis of the Daleks.
IV — Target opponent faces a villainous choice — Destroy all Dalek creatures and each of your opponents loses life equal to the total power of Daleks that died this turn, or destroy all non-Dalek creatures.
blocked_sentences: I, II, III — Create a 3/3 black Dalek artifact creature token with menace for each lore counter on Genesis of the Daleks.

IV — Target opponent faces a villainous choice — Destroy all Dalek creatures and each of your opponents loses life equal to the total power of Daleks that died this turn, or destroy all non-Dalek creatures.

needs.what: a value summing the last-known power of every creature with a given subtype (Dalek) that died this turn, by any controller, read after a destroy in the same resolution
needs.why_existing_wont_do: creatures_died_this_turn, nontoken_creatures_died_this_turn and modified_creatures_died_this_turn are counts, not power totals, and take no subtype filter; power_had and power_of read a single object, and snapshot covers only a target that left, not every Dalek that died this turn. The villainous choice shape (choose_mode with the target opponent as chooser) and the two destroy-all selectors look expressible
